explicaNucleo: Only members of the nucleus can read it: the text is encrypted on this device, and the server keeps only the ciphertext.
explicaComunidade: Only members of the community can read it: the text is encrypted on this device, and the server keeps only the ciphertext.
custos: Search finds this post only on the devices of group members.
The new-post notification comes without a preview of the text.
Whoever reports it sends the excerpt in plain text, as in the chat.
It never goes out to the Fediverse.
semAgendar: An encrypted post goes out right away: it can't be scheduled, set to disappear or have its images arranged.
semAnexo: An encrypted post carries text only: images, audio and video are not encrypted yet and would reach the server in the open.
semChave: This device is still joining the group. Try again in a few seconds.
suspeito: You can't write in this group right now: someone's key changed
falha: Couldn't encrypt right now. Nothing was posted.
semIdentidade: To write and read in encrypted groups, turn on the chat on this device first (its identity is what signs this device).

avisoForte.texto: An account this device already knew joined the group with a new device. It came signed by the person's identity, checked against the public key log. If you didn't expect it, ask them and compare the safety code in the chat.
avisoForte.trocada: This account's identity also changed (the person turned the chat on again, or someone took over the account). Confirm with them before writing anything sensitive.

naoAbreAjuda: Whoever joined the group after the post, or opens it on a new device, reads what comes from then on.
previa: In the preview, nothing is encrypted or posted.
